newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 6.14 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 6.14 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought approximately 6,138,000 lbs of beef products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced May 17:
The latest award under Announcement LS-48, Invitation 020, will be shipped between December 5 and 18, 1996.

Winning bidders for the fine frozen ground beef were Fresno Meat Co (Fresno CA) 633,600 lbs, Northern States Beef (Omaha NE) 1,980,000 lbs, Service Packing Co (Joplin MO) 792,000 lbs, H&H Meat Products Co (Mercedes, TX) 79,200 lbs, Star Ranch (Marshalltown, Iowa) 356,400 lbs, Surlean Meat Co (San Antonio, TX) 554,400 lbs, and Taylor Packing Co (Wyalusing PA) 514,800 lbs.
Winning bidders for frozen beef patties with VPP were Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 79,200 lbs, and Service Packing Co (Joplin, MO) 396,000 lbs.
Winning bidders for the frozen beef patties 100 percent beef were Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 79,200 lbs and Service Packing Company (Joplin MO) 435,600 lbs.
Winning bidders for the frozen beef patties (lean) was Country Platter (Wichita KS) 79,200 lbs, Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 158,400 lbs.
